accounting_diagnostics.result: all passed in the local float model within numerical tolerance; not a fixed-point Rust verifier run

donation_bridge_target_terminal_power.description: 20 alternatives: a strong donor at ID 0, one borderline immediate recipient at ID 1, and 18 strong alternatives at later IDs; 12 nulls. This is a purpose-built allocation diagnostic.

far_cluster_terminal_power.description: One strong donor and 10 far-offset alternatives. This probes recipient-distance mismatch.

interpretation: The immediate-next-recipient donation wins in the purpose-built bridge case; the telescope and geometric priors dilute the reserve over offsets and have lower power there.
In the far-cluster case, none of the donation policies improves power; recipient distance matters and capital allocation is not automatically useful.
Adaptive Hedge methods do not consistently beat fixed routing in this small suite.
The raw running supremum is included only as a theoretically invalid diagnostic. This finite experiment does not establish a universal miscalibration counterexample.
All reported power differences are exploratory. The per-cell Hoeffding half-width is 5.47 percentage points, and there is no simultaneous correction.
claim_boundary: No proof, confirmatory FDR/SupFDR result, Rust implementation, production benchmark or SOTA claim. The simulation only supports further experiments under the stated global-filtration and e-process assumptions.
